headline: GIFT Nifty Signals Negative Start Ahead of RBI Policy Outcome; Brent Crude Surges to $101

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Investors are awaiting the outcome of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee meeting
Rising crude oil prices are impacting market sentiment and inflation expectations
Negative global cues and declining Asian markets are weighing on domestic indices
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East have increased after an attack on a ship
whatHappening: GIFT Nifty signals a negative start for the Indian stock market today
Brent crude oil prices have surged to $101 per barrel due to supply concerns
The Sensex and Nifty 50 gained significantly in the previous trading session
Investors are awaiting the US Federal Reserve's meeting minutes for policy direction
summary: Indian markets are expected to open lower today as GIFT Nifty signals a negative start ahead of the RBI's interest rate decision. Sentiment is dampened by Brent crude surging to $101 and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East following a ship attack. While banking stocks previously supported the market, investors now await the RBI's policy outcome and US Fed minutes.
